Returns matching datasets with hours in stock, price per hour, scenarios and whic

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Full details for one DataClue dataset: overview, scenarios with measured sample specs, delivered resolution, sensors, annotation, delivery format, licensing, FAQs, sample clip URLs and price.

tools.name: get_pricing_and_terms
tools.description: DataClue's list prices, what is included, quote paths (free samples, paid pilot, volume quote, custom collection), licensing, payment and consent terms.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a request to DataClue's sales team on the user's behalf: free evaluation samples, a paid pilot, a volume quote, or a custom collection. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dataset · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: get_dataset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dataset · Private data: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote · Destructive: get_dataset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
